scope: Isolated fixtures, simulated server replies, real CSV/XLSX blobs captured without downloads.
checks: Urkunden is an active main-navigation page with its own URL and heading
The header contains the accessible page heading and the certificate icon in its green brand mark, matching the navigation icon
Certificates share the complete board navigation without Testlabor, with four service indicators and no hamburger menu
A running announcement survives navigation without cancelling, replaying or reloading
The workspace has no modal, close button, scroll lock or focus trap
Returning to the board preserves the running playback and active navigation
Returning restores the same header and retains the board tools in the workspace
An empty tournament explains missing disciplines and hides file actions without writes
Settings also save in an empty export and pin the original tournament key
Leaving saved settings returns to the board
Completed singles and doubles are selected and both file formats are available
All four output actions use the same neutral button style and distinct decorative icons
Discipline selection is a full-width table with permanently visible general settings
Date filtering starts disabled and shows selected disciplines from different days
Opting into the date filter restricts visible dates without dropping selected disciplines
The chosen date shows its own disciplines while preserving the full export selection
Disabling the date filter restores all dates and remembers the chosen date
Resetting filters also turns off the optional date filter
The global action menu opens with the keyboard and explains unavailable reset actions
Escape closes the action menu and returns focus to its trigger
Keyboard activation opens doubles placements without changing selection
Filtering hides rows while preserving selection, details and the hidden-selection count
Selecting visible rows does not select filtered disciplines
An empty filter result explains that the hidden export selection remains intact
Clearing filters restores expanded details and retains all selection state
Live results update placements without replacing focused inputs or selected discipline rows
Export status from another page updates the table without overwriting drafts or selections
New placement disciplines appear through live updates without replacing existing selections
Removed disciplines disappear while focused inputs and existing rows stay mounted
An empty discipline replacement disables adding with an explicit reason
Entering a discipline replacement enables its contextual action without saving prematurely
No selection disables both exports and explains the reason in the footer and tooltip
An invalid certificate count blocks export with an actionable reason
Enter or a form submit cannot accidentally export a file
Tab leaves the last export action without wrapping inside the workspace
An existing selection without known placements is visibly disabled
The workspace has no horizontal overflow at 1920x1080
Footer actions fit and stay reachable at 1920x1080
The final discipline is reachable through normal page scrolling at 1920x1080
The workspace has no horizontal overflow at 390x844
Footer actions fit and stay reachable at 390x844
The final discipline is reachable through normal page scrolling at 390x844
The workspace has no horizontal overflow at 320x568
Footer actions fit and stay reachable at 320x568
The final discipline is reachable through normal page scrolling at 320x568
The workspace has no horizontal overflow at 844x390
Footer actions fit and stay reachable at 844x390
The final discipline is reachable through normal page scrolling at 844x390
File generation failure sends no export mark and leaves the draft available for retry
CSV includes both visible and hidden selected disciplines and marks exactly those keys
CSV contents include both doubles partners and the custom title
A pending export blocks duplicate exports and tab navigation and locks its inputs
Acknowledged export updates the existing table statuses and releases the footer
XLSX creates a real workbook rather than a second CSV
Mark failure distinguishes the existing download from missing export status and permits retry
Resetting one discipline sends only that discipline key
A single reset preserves other disciplines export markers
Reset uses a yellow warning explaining that files and results remain
Cancelling reset has no server side effects
Explicit reset sends one guarded request and keeps the workspace busy
Reset updates table statuses and disables reset actions that now have no function
Overlapping automatic saves are serialized while newer input stays editable
The newest queued value follows the acknowledged save
Failed autosave displays the server error, preserves input and offers retry with disabled exports
The retry action fits the viewport at 320x568
The retry action fits the viewport at 844x390
Leaving failed settings asks before discarding them
Keeping failed settings retains the workspace and restores navigation focus
Retry resends the latest failed values without another file download
Switching tabs flushes the last debounced edit and waits for its acknowledgement
Successful final save switches tabs without losing settings
Explicitly discarding failed settings leaves without changing saved values
Changing tournament disposes the old workspace
A late response cannot change another tournament or close a newer workspace
Escape keeps the workspace open without native dialogs
An in-place tournament-key change cancels deferred requests instead of sending them to the new key
The legacy export URL redirects to the Urkunden page
Main navigation returns from the legacy link to the tournament board
Browser Back returns to the board without reloading the document
Browser Forward restores the Urkunden tab without reloading or restarting announcements
Combined disciplines retain their placement names and separate age-class controls in details
Readiness covers the requested places even while later placement games are unresolved
Requesting further places exposes missing ranks in the row and expanded details
Enabling a separate valuation preserves its parent row, expanded details and keyboard focus
Separate valuation details show the correct younger participant and their source discipline
Expanded details and all discipline information fit without horizontal scrolling at 390x844
Expanded details and all discipline information fit without horizontal scrolling at 320x568
Expanded details and all discipline information fit without horizontal scrolling at 844x390
The actual CSV for a separate valuation contains only its ranked participants
Removing a separate valuation preserves the parent controls and removes only its child row
Removing the workspace disposes listeners and deferred unsent requests
The export workflow produces no browser exceptions
